requirements.invariant: The caller identifies one source by typed AccountID and stable ProjectID only. Every upstream update re-resolves that identity to the current Project-directory row before filtering; candidates are only other active Projects with that current row's exact same non-null ClientID. Caller-stale Client/name/lifecycle, the source, archived destinations, different or missing Client identity, Business Inventory, name matches and row position are never eligibility authority.

Reuse the verified TransferDestinationSelectionQuerying port and source-bound selection snapshot unchanged. Every candidate carries its validated ProjectTransferRoute, stable identity and upstream Project summary; duplicate names remain valid and deterministic upstream order is preserved.

The picker is a pure projection of the existing Project-directory snapshot: no separate canonical table, SQL query, index, RLS policy, Sync Stream, completeness signal or pagination exists. TQUERY-2D53E545A090 retains unresolvedAxes empty and preserves the upstream directory fingerprint, quality, completeness, local data version and as-of time.

Waiting, partial/stale/ready candidates, incomplete empty, authoritative empty and bounded failure remain distinct. If the source ID is absent from partial/stale/incomplete upstream evidence, emit zero candidates as directory-incomplete while preserving upstream fingerprint/quality/completeness/version/time; if complete-ready evidence proves absence, emit a bounded non-enumerating source-unavailable failure. Cached candidates may be presented offline as local evidence, but neither a typed source nor local directory membership grants current server authorization.

One module-internal adapter composes the existing Account-bound Project directory into the backend-neutral Transfer destination port. It treats caller fields beyond AccountID/ProjectID as non-authoritative request material, uses the current matching directory row when represented, clears prior candidates on disappearance and never carries an old ClientID across updates. Public runtime and AppModel boundaries expose only typed Core values and structured concurrency; provider, persistence and authorization implementation details do not cross them.

This picker creates no Transfer, paired Transaction, Item move, amount, Invoice effect, payment, refund, credit, correction, Space/tag choice or accounting entry. A currently represented archived source may remain read-only source evidence and yield current same-Client active destinations; this does not expose or decide production Transfer-action eligibility for archived sources. O-002/O-011 through O-015, O-025 and D-017 are not reinterpreted.

The slice remains inside the isolated target worktree and synthetic local app. It reads no Firebase snapshot, changes no Firebase app, provisions no hosted resource and authorizes no migration, release, production operation or cutover; A-003/A-004 remain proposed.
